milestones.title: M10 — Controlled Device Administration
milestones.objective: Deliver four typed, safety-governed administration operations without generic remote execution.

workUnits.title: WU10-01 Administration domain, typed commands, and privilege handling
workUnits.objective: Implement the closed administration model, fixed commands, conflict guard, and sudo -n failure handling.
acceptanceCriteria: No arbitrary command or unit input

workUnits.title: WU10-02 Restart Device with expected-offline verification
workUnits.objective: Verify restart as offline then online, with bounded persisted expected disruption.

workUnits.title: WU10-03 Controlled shutdown and planned-offline semantics
workUnits.objective: Complete shutdown end-to-end without a Power On capability.

workUnits.title: WU10-04 Docker and Tailscale restart operations
workUnits.objective: Implement narrow typed service restarts with verification.

workUnits.title: WU10-05 Administration UI, integration, and closure
workUnits.objective: Add device-details UI, confirmations, busy/result/planned-offline presentation and closure evidence.

dependencies.reason: Shared administration domain and command safety boundary are required.
Shutdown uses the same typed operation model.
Service restarts use the same fixed operation model.
UI consumes operation and planned-offline state.

extension.reason: Replace the M10 planning placeholder with the five approved implementation work units.
